1. `ls -la /Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/Android/aar/`
2. `find /Users/jace/Documents/newapp -iname "*1.5.8*" -not -path "*/node_modules/*" 2>/dev/null`
3. `cat /Users/jace/Documents/newapp/SDK/Android/VERSION 2>/dev/null`
4. `find / -iname "WeiKeSdk_1.5.8.aar" 2>/dev/null` (在整个文件系统查找是否有缓存的 1.5.8 aar，限时执行，找不到就算了)
